summary: Stale-store hints must send users to `pull` (area-scoped harvest), and 401/404 hints must describe Immoweb's no-auth reality (bot protection, removed listings), not API credentials or a generic list command.
reason: The generic `sync` command has no area filter and would page through every Belgian listing; this API has no credentials, so a 401/403 means bot protection and a 404 usually means the listing was sold or withdrawn.
